_comment: Release notes, newest first (releases.js). A release's files are in R2, listed by release-files.json; a beta is prerelease: true with its compat.json and ROM_FEATURES.md beside its files in release-files/<tag>/. downloadsOnGitHub: every file's downloads while GitHub hosted them (GitHub's own total, release-note images included: 107,235 app files + 20,844 image views), from the project hub's last sync before the suspension.

releases.name: v1.6.2.2
releases.body:
PokeDaisy 1.6.2.2 is 1.6.2.1 with its updates and downloads moved to PokeDaisy's own website. Install the APK over your PokeDaisy: your games, saves and settings stay.

## Fixes

- UPDATES: the app now looks for new versions on pokedaisy.com, and every download (Android, Windows, Linux, 3DS) is on the site.
- 1.6.2.1's fix is in it too: games open again on the Anbernic RG Rotate instead of closing at once.

Everything else is the same as 1.6.2: see its notes below.

releases.name: v1.6.2.1
releases.body:
A hotfix for 1.6.2.

## Fixes

- RG ROTATE: games open again on the Anbernic RG Rotate instead of closing at once.

releases.name: v1.6.2
releases.body:
PokeDaisy 1.6.2 has the Android APK, PokeDaisy for Windows for the first time, the Linux and PortMaster zips, and the 3DS .3dsx and CIA. Install the APK over your PokeDaisy: your games, saves and settings stay.

Thanks to everyone who tried the two betas and told us what they found.

## New

- NEW GAMES: Clover, Elysium, Sacred Gold and Storm Silver, Oops All Eevees!, Rhythm, Ceruleum, RecordKeepers, Red and Yellow with Gen II Graphics, Italian Unbound and the German Platinum. Thanks @marthinmooy, @mc6415 and @DFelten
- WINDOWS: PokeDaisy for 64-bit Windows, with the companion, HUD, quick menu and EXPAND, and DS games on the app's own melonDS engine. Guide: [Install on Windows](https://pokedaisy.com/docs/windows-install/). Thanks @drake-dot-o
- NEW LOOK: the menus in the games' summary style in PokeDaisy's blue (a THEME moves them to its own colour), a move page, and FONT to pick the app's letters
- POKEMON PICTURES: each Pokemon's own picture on PARTY, in the summary, in battle and on the HUD
- SUMMARY: drag a Pokemon's moves into a new order, and see an egg's types and stats before it hatches. Thanks @ZTMYO
- ITEM POPUPS and MOVE ADVICE: a card when you pick up an item, and advice on which move to forget. Thanks @ZTMYO
- BATTLE INFO: the foe's nature. Thanks @ZTMYO
- GAME BOY GAMES: shiny Pokemon, RUNNING SHOES, EXP SHARE, INSTANT TEXT, REUSABLE TMS, NUZLOCKE and their DVs on STATS. Thanks @marthinmooy and @mc6415
- DS GAMES: INSTANT TEXT, REUSABLE TMS, EXP SHARE, SHINY ODDS, NUZLOCKE and IVs and EVs on STATS. Thanks @mc6415
- RUBY AND SAPPHIRE: HIDE BATTLE MENU, the POKEMON switch, LAST BALL, EXP SHARE, LEVEL CAP and the PC's moves
- FIRERED 1.0: DEX, GUIDE, the HUD's WILD and REPEL STEPS, and its Pokemon's pictures in the SAVE EDITOR. Thanks @DFelten
- ORIGIN HEARTGOLD: move categories, BATTLE BUTTONS, and its TMs shown as never running out, as in the game. Thanks @milesjos
- DS CORE: BANANADS, a third DS emulator, on Android 10 and up. Thanks @JorreFog
- TRAINER CARD: on the German, French, Italian and Spanish FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald
- BOXES: sort a box by Pokedex number, and take Mail to the PC from the summary. Thanks @ZTMYO and @gal-leib
- SAVE EDITOR: a Pokemon's front picture on its page. Thanks @kc4401cn
- FOLD LAYOUT: an ALWAYS mode and touch controls on the bottom half. Thanks @owenlejeune
- BETA UPDATES: try new versions before everyone else, in Settings > APP
- LINUX: the app's library as the game list, with covers, menus in French, German, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese, and the German HeartGold, SoulSilver, Black, White, Black 2 and White 2 on the DS core. Thanks @saschb2b
- 3DS: GBA games on an Old 3DS (GBA CORE AUTO), the CIA for the HOME Menu, the German Crystal, Gold and Silver, menus in French, German, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese, and faster saves. Thanks @Slickmaxim and @DFelten

## Fixes

- DS ON ONE SCREEN: the music keeps playing through menus, no touch screen floating in before every battle or after a move, Gen 5 no longer leaves an empty touch screen after a battle, HeartGold's starter pick shows side by side, and the touch screen comes up when Gen 5 asks for a move to forget or Black 2 / White 2 asks for a name
- DS AT NORMAL SPEED: on 120 Hz screens every frame now shows, and frames are skipped only once a game really falls behind (no more 30 FPS dips in battles). Thanks @DFelten
- DS GAMES: no dark bar over the game. Thanks @DFelten
- DS EXPAND: no boxes or lavender slabs at area borders in HeartGold, SoulSilver and Platinum, and a move that raises or lowers a stat no longer smears the HP boxes across the sides. Thanks @DFelten
- EXPAND: weather now fills the whole view when you zoom out
- GEN 5 NICKNAMES: the party shows ♂ and ♀, not ⑭ and ⑮. Thanks @mc6415
- AUTO-RUN, RUN INDOORS and WILD ENCOUNTERS: keep working after you go HOME and come back
- FLY on the MAP: the list closes when you pick a place, and a DS flight closes the HUD's map
- HIDE BATTLE MENU: works in Ultra Violet (thanks g47L0Rd-68), and the game's own menu stays in the tutorial battles
- SHINY ALERT: no second alert for the same shiny in the next battle. Thanks g47L0Rd-68
- ACHIEVEMENTS: progress pop-ups only when you get further than before, and a game with no set yet says so instead of loading forever. Thanks M0UL
- BATTLE TAB: no flash to INFO while you move the cursor in a Game Boy battle. Thanks @DFelten
- HUD: steps aside for text boxes and the START menu on ORIGINAL and STRETCH too
- QUICK MENU: the grid stands in where the ring has no room (thanks highfiverobot), and its settings list only the actions the open game has
- FOLLOWER: drawn over you when it walks below you
- WEAK DEVICES: games run lighter, with EXPAND on too. Thanks @gal-leib
- CHEATS: read when a game starts, not every time you flip one. Thanks @gal-leib
- ASPECT on DSPERATE: EXPAND says it isn't available there, instead of NOT YET
- TAB BAR: no old word left under a tab's new name when BATTLE takes a place
- SEARCH BOXES: the D-pad stops on them without bringing up the keyboard
- UPRIGHT COMPANION: a tap on the grip hides it when it's at its tallest
- ZIPPED GAMES: names with accents open, and a zip of another console's game is no longer listed as a GBA game
- SAVE EDITOR: saves it would misread aren't offered, and a bag item's new amount shows in the list at once
- LINUX: the button that closes the companion stays out of the game, B no longer closes the game list, the button marked A is A on ROCKNIX, the HUD comes back as soon as a menu closes, the companion keeps its size on every screen, TAB BAR lists only the tabs the game has, and MAP shows games with big map art. Thanks @saschb2b and @windler
- PORTMASTER ON MUOS: the launcher finds games in the firmware's ROMS folder, and the install guide puts the script and the folder where muOS looks for them
- 3DS: full speed with sound on an Old 3DS, MAP's PLACES and FLY lists no longer go black around the list, the European games' accented letters show, and TAB BAR lists only the tabs the game has. Thanks @Theosaurus-Rex

## Install on a 3DS with FBI

Scan this in FBI (Remote Install > Scan QR Code) to put PokeDaisy on the HOME Menu, or download pokedaisy.cia and install it from the SD card. For the Homebrew Launcher, take pokedaisy.3dsx. The guide: https://pokedaisy.com/docs/3ds/

releases.name: v1.6.1
releases.body:
A quick fix release for 1.6.0's slowdowns on Android and for games that wouldn't start on the 3DS. The Linux files are the same as 1.6.0's.

## Fixes

- Normal speed: games no longer stutter or lag at 1x on 120 Hz screens (AYN Thor, Retroid Pocket 6 and many phones), where fast forward stayed smooth. This takes back 1.6.0's change for DS at 1x on 120 Hz screens. Thanks Mojako10, alan-carpenter, tscholle and katsuuu7345
- DS games: the top screen no longer gets stuck white at launch or when you open the trainer card. Thanks YellowRed1705 and asura0106
- Library: your games stay listed after you update, instead of disappearing until a long scan finished, and a long folder scan keeps what it has found if you leave. Thanks Ablakane91
- FLY in Unbound: works with any Pokemon the game's own menu would fly with, even one that doesn't know the move. Thanks ghanni
- DS on one screen: SHADERS reach the battle buttons and messages too. Thanks slinkyair
- Archives: a zip with no game inside says so instead of closing the app
- 3DS: games start again from the HOME Menu (CIA) and on the original 3DS, instead of "no memory for the game". Thanks RandyRoofman, fluffehwolfie and everyone who sent their log
- 3DS: your settings stay saved between starts, and a game that doesn't start says why
- 3DS: EXPAND now starts off, for speed. Turn it on in VIEW

## Install on a 3DS with FBI

Scan this in FBI (Remote Install > Scan QR Code) to put PokeDaisy on the HOME Menu, or download pokedaisy.cia and install it from the SD card. For the Homebrew Launcher, take pokedaisy.3dsx. The guide: https://pokedaisy.com/docs/3ds/

releases.name: v1.6.0
releases.body:
## New platforms

- 3DS: a first build, an early preview with the companion, the library, a save editor and trade. Made for the New 3DS, and the original 3DS and 2DS get GPSP, an experimental GBA CORE (press X on a game in the library). Start it from the Homebrew Launcher (pokedaisy.3dsx) or install it on the HOME Menu with FBI (pokedaisy.cia, or scan the QR code below). Thanks @ratherDashing for armGBA and bheppe for gpSP 3D. The guide: https://pokedaisy.com/docs/3ds/
- Linux: builds for the Steam Deck, Linux PCs and handhelds (TrimUI, PortMaster, NXRedux), and libretro cores. Thanks @keeganwhitacre and @thwonp. The guide: https://pokedaisy.com/docs/linux-install/

## New features

- FREE FLIGHT: take off from the MAP tab, the quick menu or a hotkey and fly over the map yourself, in FireRed, Emerald and most hacks
- Scenic FLY: FLY takes you there through the sky. FLY STYLE brings back the classic way
- FLY ON and RIDE ON: fly in a balloon, a helicopter, a zeppelin or a plane, and ride a motorcycle or a scooter instead of the bike
- New games: Epsilon Emerald, Heartfelt Gold, Pokemon Brown, Blaze Black 2 and Volt White 2 Redux v1.4.1, Team Rocket Edition 2026 v3.1, Monomyth v1.2, Renegade Platinum's patches, and German Red, Blue, Crystal, Gold and Silver. Thanks YellowRed1705 and @DFelten
- GAME LOOK: the companion and the HUD in each game's own colours, for HeartGold, Platinum, Black and White and their sequels, FireRed, Emerald and Ruby and Sapphire. COMPANION LOOK CLASSIC keeps the old one
- GAMEPLAY options for the GBA games: NO HMS NEEDED, EXP SHARE (SPLIT or FULL EXP), LEVEL CAP at the next boss's level, AUTO REFILL for the spray that keeps wild Pokemon away, SHINY ALERT with an encounter count and BOSS RETRY
- POKEMON CENTER anywhere: heal your party, relearn or forget a move and give a nickname, from the summary or the quick menu's HEAL
- SAVE EDITOR, round two: a Pokemon's own page (nature, ability, IVs, EVs, level, shiny, friendship, nickname), the party, box tools (rename, sort, search, release), the Pokedex and the event tickets. Now for HeartGold, SoulSilver, Platinum, Diamond, Pearl, Black, White, Black 2 and White 2 saves too
- PAL PARK and POKE TRANSFER: bring six Pokemon at a time from a GBA save to HeartGold, SoulSilver or Platinum, and from there to Black, White and their sequels, the way the games did it
- COLLECTION, MISSING and TRADE AND BACK: every save's Pokemon in one list, what each Pokedex still lacks and which of your saves can send it, and trade evolutions in one go
- HIDE BATTLE MENU: on two screens, pick from the companion and keep the game's battle menu off the top screen
- AREA maps: caves and big buildings get their own map on the MAP tab, floor by floor
- DS CORE: a second DS emulator, faster on weaker devices. AUTO picks it for you
- FLY in more hacks: Seaglass, Too Many Types 2, R.O.W.E., Super Mariomon 1.5, Quetzal Alpha 9, Epsilon Emerald, Heartfelt Gold and Pokemon Brown
- Polished Crystal: EXPAND widens the overworld
- Unbound: change your party's order from the companion. Thanks @NavrajBal
- Save states: press and hold a slot to delete it. Thanks @ZTMYO

## Smaller additions

- LAST BALL: the BATTLE tab throws the ball you used last in a wild battle
- QUICK MENU: TURBO A holds A down for you until you tap it again, and TOUCH SCREEN brings a DS game's touch screen in on one screen
- LOW HP BEEP and FIELD POISON: turn off the low health beep, and stop poison hurting your Pokemon while you walk
- SPRITE PACK: the makeover's looks from one pack file instead of your other games
- FONT: the app's letters in pixels, smooth or your device's own
- DESCRIPTIONS and GROUP TABS: hide the settings' descriptions or their group tabs
- RESET TO DEFAULTS: for GAME BUTTONS and HOTKEYS. Thanks highfiverobot
- Companion: a held D-pad keeps moving through lists on stick and hat controllers. Thanks highfiverobot
- STATS: a Pokemon's ability on its summary. Thanks @ZTMYO
- Achievements: turn the popups off, and tap a summary's highlighted slot again for its DEX entry. Thanks @ZTMYO
- FLIGHT AREA: fly only over places you've been, or ANYWHERE
- DS TOUCH SCREEN: STRETCH fills the second screen with the touch screen
- D-PAD keys: put more keys on the D-pad in GAME BUTTONS, for controllers like the 8BitDo Micro. Thanks alphador
- BATTLE VIEW: can open on SUGGESTIONS. Thanks YellowRed1705
- CHALLENGE ICONS: hide RetroAchievements' challenge badges in the companion. Thanks clint9smith
- Library: linked folders list every Pokemon game, the ones without a companion tagged NOT SUPPORTED. Thanks Achyuth072
- Website: real screens of the app, and a download for each platform
- A new app icon, and new TOOLS icons in the library
- A smaller download: the APK is 6.5 MB lighter. Thanks @gal-leib for the Kotlin 2 upgrade behind it

## Fixes

- DS on weaker devices: smoother play, skipping a frame when a device can't keep up, and DS CPU BOOST starts off on slow devices
- Smoother play: a game that turns choppy gets smooth again by itself
- DS at 1x on 120 Hz screens: even frames, as smooth as in fast forward. Thanks YellowRed1705
- STEADY music: comes back after the screen sleeps, like the AYN Thor's lid closed and opened. Thanks @DFelten
- DS battles on one screen: the companion's tab stays where you can tap it, and double and triple battles show the target choice, Renegade Platinum's too. Thanks DarioFranzese and norcut
- HeartGold and SoulSilver on one screen: a menu the game puts on the touch screen, like the PC's, floats in. Thanks nyx
- BATTLE BUTTONS on one screen: the move list's PP and verdict fit again. Thanks final_remix
- SAVE EDITOR: Emerald saves whose party the game has emptied open again. Thanks roy_yamaha
- Black and White on one screen: the X menu no longer cuts the music. Thanks Yreg06
- Radical Red: wild Pokemon follow the game's clock. Thanks Primogenitor33
- HUD WILD: levels and odds no longer cut off on some screens. Thanks highfiverobot
- RetroAchievements: a game started offline tells you its achievements are off. Thanks highfiverobot
- CHEATS: a list of thousands of codes, like Platinum's, no longer freezes the app
- NUZLOCKE: the catching tutorial no longer counts as an encounter
- EXPAND on Game Boy: people at the screen's edge show where the game has them. Thanks zachlarriveepion-ctrl
- AUTO-RUN: no longer closes Recharged Yellow's START menu. Thanks YellowRed1705
- BATTLE STYLE: a pick shows at once, without restarting the game. Thanks mcadas
- Phones upright: UNDER GAME keeps the touch controls their own space without EXPAND too
- Ghost Grey: its companion is removed at its developer's request. The game still plays

## Install on a 3DS with FBI

Scan this in FBI (Remote Install > Scan QR Code) to put PokeDaisy on the HOME Menu, or download pokedaisy.cia and install it from the SD card. For the Homebrew Launcher, take pokedaisy.3dsx. The guide: https://pokedaisy.com/docs/3ds/

releases.name: v1.5.0.1
releases.body:
## New

- New games: Monomyth v1.1, Yellow Legacy, Crystal Legacy, Renegade Platinum (1.2.0, 1.3.0 and Classic) and Modern Emerald 3.6. Thanks rubyte17 and YellowRed1705
- KOREAN: the whole app in Korean
- Fresh look: a refreshed HUD, quick menu and battle buttons, with new animations
- DS in more languages: HeartGold to White 2 in French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese and Korean, and Platinum in Spanish. Thanks sergio-losito-deda and SilverSteelclaw
- DS on one screen: menus load faster, behind a steady picture instead of the fades
- CHEATS on DS: Action Replay DS codes, added the same way as GBA cheats. Thanks YellowRed1705 and m-bartlett
- INSTANT TEXT: the GBA games' dialogue shows all at once. Thanks YellowRed1705
- BATTLE STYLE: a Gen 5 battle screen for the companion, beside the Gen 4 one
- PARTY: hold a Pokemon and drag it onto another to change the order, or use SWITCH in its summary. Thanks Sleqa
- Field moves: teach TMs from the bag, FLASH from the quick menu, and the whole PC menu anywhere
- Library: search your games, show SUPPORTED ONLY, GAME NAMES to list them by file name, and ADD TO HOME for a game's own icon. Thanks agergo100 and YellowRed1705
- FOLD LAYOUT: a half open foldable puts the game and the companion on either side of the hinge. Thanks notmtndrew589-ops
- Touch controls: new layouts, looks and colours, X and Y buttons, ZOOM and REWIND buttons, VIBRATION with its STRENGTH, and Delta skins

## Smaller additions

- Move icons: every move shows whether it's physical, special or status. Thanks Sleqa
- BATTLE VIEW and BATTLE INFO: the BATTLE tab can open on INFO, or show only the battle buttons. Thanks biomagnet
- Battle INFO: a ball on the foe's card when you've caught that Pokemon. Thanks lepercan
- WILD: KEEP OPEN leaves the HUD's wild list up while you walk from map to map. Thanks darreoncollins
- DEX: filter by name and type, and see where the Pokemon you own are kept
- ZOOM: pick EXPAND's zoom in SETTINGS, for devices without a right stick, and LOOK AROUND turns the right stick off. Thanks scandragon
- Phones upright: hide the companion and give the game the whole screen, and the COMPANION hotkey brings it back. Thanks Davaeds and E-boyBoxed
- DS with two screens: the COMPANION hotkey swaps the second screen between the touch screen and the companion
- AYANEO Pocket DS: the companion on its bottom screen. Thanks Big4520
- Quetzal: the MAP has Hoenn and Johto too, beside Kanto and Sevii
- AUDIO EFFECTS: the game's sound through your device's equalizer apps. Thanks KylerN45
- EXPAND: now on Crystal Clear too. Thanks XOmniverse
- 32-bit devices: the same APK now installs on 32-bit Android
- Website: in every language the app speaks, with a games search and a page for each game
- Linux handhelds and the libretro core: the shared companion, Polished Crystal and the DS companion's controls. Thanks keeganwhitacre, thwonp and ryanmsartor

## Fixes

- Slower devices: the companion draws faster, and touch presses reach the game while it's busy
- Tablets: the companion window and the HUD's map and summary no longer fill the whole screen
- SoulGold: switching Pokemon from the companion follows your PARTY MENU option. Thanks jdelcarp-crypto
- SoulGold v1.2.1: moves and PP show right, and FLY finds a flyer past your first Pokemon
- Smoother play: steadier frames on the RG DS and other screens that tick unevenly. Thanks iza2804 and okean-izaiaspereira
- Unbound: no more white box behind the text boxes with EXPAND on, and no stray strip when a level up slides in. Thanks Griizly
- RetroArch saves: compressed saves load
- Freezes: fewer on RESTART GAME, on big .7z games and on removing a ROMs folder
- HUD: steps aside for the touch buttons in its corners, and editing the touch controls no longer moves it. Thanks NuxArden
- DS: the LCD grid and the other filters cover the bottom screen too. Thanks NeonNobility
- DS: RetroAchievements popups show over the game. Thanks eraser2011
- DS: RESTART GAME keeps EXPAND and the zoom with DS RESOLUTION on
- DS on one screen: the forced party, the move to forget, the naming screens and Black 2's party after "Will you switch your Pokemon?" show where they should
- Thor: an app left on the bottom screen no longer leaves its bars over the companion
- FOLLOWER: walks in Emerald Legacy and the other newer hacks. Thanks Syphist
- STEADY music: works in Crystal Clear, Gold, Silver and Polished Crystal. Thanks whitt-e
- Yellow with EXPAND: NPCs stay whole at the edge of the view. Thanks zachlarriveepion-ctrl
- AUTO-RUN: no longer brings you up while you Dive in Emerald, and leaves SoulGold's and Odyssey's own running alone. Thanks Sage0414
- Move ratings: status moves get none, and Freeze-Dry, Flying Press and Thousand Arrows are rated right. Thanks Sleqa
- LEARN: offers the move the game is asking about at that level
- Lazarus with EXPAND: the lamp post lights draw right. Thanks qorrymarzuki
- Updates: the updater tries Android's own installer first. Thanks KewaiiGamer
- Older GPUs: games no longer crash on opening when the system claims OpenGL ES 3 the GPU doesn't have. Thanks KewaiiGamer

## Hotfix

- ROTATING: turning a Samsung Galaxy sideways in a game no longer closes the app or sends you back to the library

1.5.0.1 is a hotfix for 1.5.0: everything above is what 1.5.0 brought, and this fix is the only change since.

releases.name: v1.4.0
releases.body:
## New

- DS on one screen: hold your device sideways and the touch screen floats in when the game needs it. Pick from five layouts in SETTINGS > DS LAYOUT, and use L2 for the touch screen and R2 for the next layout
- New DS games: Pokemon White, Black 2, White 2, Origin HeartGold, and German HeartGold and SoulSilver. Thanks sm4rthom3
- New GBA games: Let's Go, Monomyth, Team Rocket Edition 2026 (Spanish), SoulGold v1.2.1, and randomized FireRed and Emerald. Thanks @aelias22
- BOXES: your PC's boxes in the companion. Move Pokemon between a box and your party
- THEME: colour the app and the companion, with eight new themes and a few for the holidays
- TRADE EVOLUTIONS: evolve a Pokemon that needs a trade, from its summary
- GAME VOLUME: a volume slider, MUTE GAME and a MUTE hotkey
- BATTLE FOCUS: battle INFO on one page. Thanks @Sleqa
- DS CPU BOOST: fewer slowdowns in the DS games
- SAVE BACKUPS: turn them off, pick how many to keep, or keep them all in one folder
- TOOLS: PATCH A ROM, LINK PLAY (two to four GBA games on one link cable), SAVE EDITOR (a game's boxes, bag and money) and TRADE SAVES (Pokemon between your games' saves)
- Linux handhelds: an optional DS backend. Thanks @keeganwhitacre

## Fixes

- Game Boy sound: no more crackle in Yellow, Crystal and the other Game Boy games. Thanks zachlarriveepion-ctrl
- Sound: no more wobble in the music's pitch while you play. Thanks Chip-Damage-TM
- Black: a party of six no longer blanks the companion. Thanks SunlessBrackin
- Black 2 and White 2: the battle's text box looks like the game's, and the bag shows the item you pick
- Platinum: the battle buttons press the right moves. Thanks @keeganwhitacre

releases.name: v1.3.3
releases.body:
## New

- New games: Pokemon Black on the DS, Wishes of Tomorrow, PureRed / PureBlue and Dreamstone Mysteries
- SHINY ODDS: pick how often wild Pokemon are shiny. Shiny ones get their own icons and marks
- NUZLOCKE: a new tab that keeps score of your run
- DS RESOLUTION: the DS games' 3D drawn sharper, up to 8x
- GUIDE for Yellow, Red, Blue and Crystal
- TIPS: now and then a card about a feature you haven't tried yet
- Several ROMs folders: link just your gba, gbc and nds folders, from + in the library or SETTINGS > FOLDERS
- GAME BUTTONS: the DS games' X and Y can be moved on their own
- SETTINGS > DISCORD to join the community
- Linux handhelds: an early build you can make from source, for Game Boy, Game Boy Color and GBA. Thanks @keeganwhitacre

## Fixes

- Fast-forward takes effect as soon as you turn it on
- Loud Game Boy music no longer crackles
- Hotkeys with SELECT or START no longer swallow that button in the game, and no longer fire later by themselves. Thanks Griizly
- WILD ENCOUNTERS: turning it back on always brings the wild Pokemon back. Thanks YellowRed1705
- A cover you picked comes back after an update. Thanks VAsHachiRoku
- Zipped DS games show up in your ROMs folder. Thanks VAsHachiRoku
- FOLLOWER and DAY AND NIGHT no longer carry over to the next game you open
- A Game Boy game opened after a GBA hack no longer shows the hack's map

releases.name: v1.3.2
releases.body:
## New

- Phones held upright: the game on top, the companion in the middle and the touch controls at the bottom. DS games put the touch screen in the companion's place
- X and Y on the touch controls in DS games
- DS games held sideways on one screen: the D-pad and buttons sit in the bottom corners, with SELECT and START between them
- A COMPANION hotkey that opens the companion on one screen, or brings it back after CLOSE COMPANION. Thanks @moronigranja
- The party shows nicknames in the Game Boy games, R.O.W.E. and Elite Redux too. Thanks @benjamimcoelho

## Fixes

- GBA games no longer crash when you close them
- Fewer crashes while a game runs with cheats or game options on
- Gold and Silver are listed under GBC
- SoulGold's special shiny Pokemon show as shiny in the party
- SoulGold: NEXT BOSS follows the Elite Four and Clair. Thanks @SylanaZero
- AUTO-RUN no longer gets in the way of the DexNav's creep (hold A) in Seaglass
- The library no longer freezes while it reads new games
- The bar that moves your buttons to the companion is easier to see

releases.name: v1.3.1
releases.body:
## MAKEOVER

A new group at the top of the companion's SETTINGS, in the games it works in:

- PLAYER LOOK: play FireRed, LeafGreen, Ruby, Sapphire or Emerald (and Kaizo, Legacy, Imperium and Ultra Violet) as another game's hero, or as one of your party's Pokemon. The sprites come from your own ROMs and your save never changes
- RIVAL LOOK: Emerald, Ruby and Sapphire's rival wears the look's other hero
- TEXT LOOK: FireRed's text box and font in Emerald, Emerald's in FireRed and LeafGreen
- FOLLOWER: your lead Pokemon walks behind you
- DAY AND NIGHT: the map's colours follow your device's clock

## More games

- Team Rocket Edition: Dragonsden Version 1.5

## New

- X and Y in GAME BUTTONS. With the companion on the other screen, X hands your buttons to the companion on the field, like a DS game's menu
- EXPAND keeps each game's ZOOM and eases back in once you're on the field
- SETTINGS on a wide screen: its groups as tabs down the left side, following the cursor
- The companion fits the RG DS's screen

## Fixes

- Smoother frame pacing on DS and GBA games, and steadier fast-forward
- Sharper game pixels: no more jagged edges
- RetroAchievements on DS games, and after resuming a game
- DS games on one screen show their touch screen too
- DS games' names come from the cart
- Polished Crystal is listed under GBC
- The party shows nicknames, like the game's party menu
- Odyssey's own species, types and moves
- Unbound FR's own party art
- SoulGold: shiny party icons, and REPEL, ROD and BIKE in the QUICK MENU
- A resumed game's held items show in its own language right away
- DEX AREA no longer says "Not found in the wild" on a first visit
- The library looks six folders deep, and hidden copies no longer hide linked games
- Platinum's fog reaches EXPAND's margins, and EXPAND's battle margins no longer mirror a window at the edge
- Fixed a crash with some save files

releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
## Nintendo DS

- Pokemon Platinum, HeartGold and SoulSilver (USA) on melonDS, with the companion: party, bag, map, dex and guide, read from your own cart
- On two screens the DS touch screen goes on the bottom screen, and one tap swaps it for the companion
- EXPAND draws the DS games' 3D overworld past the screen's edges, battles too
- PC anywhere, FLY, wild encounters off, smart fast-forward and steady fast-forward music on the DS games

## More games

- Pokemon Red, Blue, Gold and Silver
- Polished Crystal 3.2.0 to 3.2.3 (all 16 builds), with the first Game Boy guide: wild Pokemon, next boss, where is and tips
- Elite Redux (2.65.3b, 2.65.4.1b), Ghost Grey (1.0.1, 1.0.2, 1.0.4) and Quetzal Alpha 9 v1 (English and Spanish)
- Lazarus: the guide shows the night's wild Pokemon by the game's clock

## Game Boy

- EXPAND, ZOOM and look-around on Yellow and Crystal, plus the HUD and steady fast-forward music on Crystal
- PC anywhere, FLY and wild encounters off on Red, Blue, Yellow and Crystal
- Battle picks no longer get lost when the game drops a press

## New options

- REUSABLE TMS: a TM stays in the bag after it teaches a move
- UNLIT SCREEN: the first GBA's screen with no light behind it, under SHADERS
- LIGHT COMPANION: a lighter companion for slower devices, so the game's buttons answer at once
- TOUCH CONTROLS: layouts, size, opacity, extra buttons and EDIT LAYOUT to move each button, with a preview
- MORE: the tabs that don't fit the tab bar wait there as app icons
- COMPANION BUTTON: hide the edge button that opens the companion on one screen
- DARK MODE changes with each tap

## Library and screens

- Quick views in the library: ALL, FAVORITES, RECENT, GB, GBC, GBA, DS and HACKS
- SWAP SCREENS trades the DS games' screens too
- Swapped, CLOSE COMPANION keeps the game on the second screen, with the companion over the game there
- A TV as the second screen gets the game, the phone keeps the companion

## Fixes

- Turning the screen off no longer restarts the game
- FLY no longer gives a black screen or resets the game
- Wild encounters come back when you turn them on again after a resume
- DS games no longer flicker at fast-forward
- Game Boy games no longer crash when they close
- Fixed a crash with the dual-screen launcher and the D-pad, and a crash after waking or restarting a game
- Upright phones: the companion's grip keeps its own strip
- EXPAND: SoulGold's battle scenery and party screen
- The HUD page in SETTINGS works with the D-pad from its first row

releases.name: v1.2.1
releases.body:
## Game Boy Color

- Pokemon Crystal, Crystal Clear and Prism: party, bag, map, dex and battle on the companion
- Pokemon Yellow in German, French, Italian and Spanish
- Switch Pokemon in battle from the companion on Yellow and the Crystal games

## More games

- Recharged Emerald (v2.2.5, v2.2.8 and Rebalanced), Emerald Legacy 1.1.4, GS Chronicles, FireRed Rocket Edition, Ash Gray, Quetzal Alpha 0.8.4 (plus its Moemon builds)
- German LeafGreen
- Collection and flash-cart copies of FireRed and Emerald are recognized as the original game
- Trainer cards for SoulGold, Lazarus and Recharged Yellow

## One-screen devices

- The companion opens as a window over the game (or a side panel, your pick)
- HUD on the overworld: your party, a minimap, Poke Balls, BAG, PC and WILD buttons, and Repel steps left
- QUICK MENU on a button (L3): PC, Fly, Repel, bike, rod, wild encounters, save states and more
- FIGHT, POKEMON and RUN beside the game in battles, with move and party lists
- Navigate every companion tab with the D-pad
- Dual-screen devices: SINGLE SCREEN plays on one screen and frees the other for your apps, with the companion over the game

## Do more from anywhere

- Open the PC from the bag, anywhere (every retail language and many hacks)
- Fly from the MAP tab on many more games and languages

## Speed and gameplay

- Scene speeds: battles, text, menus, bike and surf each at their own speed
- Auto-run and running indoors
- Wild encounters on or off
- Restart game and close app hotkeys
- Rebind any button by pressing it

## Settings

- Ordered by how often you change them, with a short description under each option
- Rarely changed options moved to SPEED OPTIONS and DISPLAY OPTIONS pages
- Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal)
- Phones: smaller text and pop-ups that always fit, and the app stays left to right on right-to-left phones

## Fixes

- Fast-forward on 120 Hz screens ran 4x too fast
- Audio hiccups at normal speed
- A save in progress now finishes before the game closes
- No more "internal battery has run dry" from cartridge saves (Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald)
- EXPAND: Unbound's menus and SoulGold's item windows no longer dim the screen
- Amethyst shows its own moves
- SoulGold: no stray item tag on a Pokemon holding nothing

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.body:
## Performance

- Smoother gameplay: frames now line up with the screen's refresh
- Fast-forward is smoother too, every frame moves the game the same amount
- Runs cooler, especially at fast-forward
- Games open much faster: the companion shows your party and bag right away when resuming
- Battle taps register instantly, no more delay before the game reacts (most ROMs)
- Switching Pokemon in battle takes a split second
- FPS / CPU overlay if you want to check for yourself

## Expanded view (widescreen)

- The overworld now fills wide screens drawn live past the GBA's edges
- Zoom out with R3 to see more around you
- Look around with the right stick
- Zooms back in by itself for text, menus and battles (or turn off AUTO ZOOM IN)
- Works on every retail Gen 3 game and most supported hacks
- Still a work in progress so expect a glitch here and there (reports welcome)

## Do more from the companion

- Use medicine, vitamins, PP items and Repels straight from the bag
- Give and take held items
- Fly to any visited town from the MAP tab (FireRed, LeafGreen, Emerald)
- Star your favorite bag items
- DEX now shows evolutions, where to catch and learnable moves
- Move advice: what to learn, what to forget, and who can use your TMs

## Battles

- ONE-TAP MOVES puts your moves right on the main battle menu
- Foe details: ability, held item, stats, stat changes and its moves

## 9 new games

- Glazed, Emerald Imperium, Quetzal (EN/ES), Orange Islands, Ultra Violet, Sword and Shield Ultimate Plus, Recharged Yellow, Super Mariomon, Emerald Kaizo
- Plus Unbound in French, full R.O.W.E. companion, another SoulGold 1.2 build
- Unknown ROM? PokeDaisy tries to figure out the game, or lets you pick it

## Look and feel

- Dark mode
- Edge-smoothing shaders (xBRZ, xBR, ScaleFX)
- Overlays, including your own RetroArch ones

## Controls

- Rewind
- Game speed from 0.25x to 4x, plus 1.5x fast-forward
- Turbo A / B
- Soft reset hotkey

## Library

- NEW tags, sorting and favorites
- Use your RetroArch save folders as they are
- Built-in user manual (works offline)
- Settings search
- Retroid Pocket Duo Lite layout
- Optional crash reports to help fix bugs faster: off by default, the app asks you once, and you can change it in Settings > CRASH REPORTS

## Languages

- Guides fully translated for non-English games
- Type names in the game’s language

## Fixes

- No more slowdown at the Poke Mart while fast-forwarding
- Status bar crash on single-screen devices fixed
- Hotkeys actually stay off when turned off

releases.name: v1.1.4
releases.body:
## Fixes

- **No more screen tearing.** Scrolling in a game (walking around a town, for example) could show a line across the screen, with half of one frame over half of the next. The game screen now only shows finished frames, as RetroArch does.
- **Steady fast-forward music works in Pokémon Heart and Soul.** It used to fall back to sped-up sound there. Both of its soundtracks are recorded, so whichever one you play with keeps its normal speed in fast-forward. The first time you open the game, its music is recorded in the background.

releases.name: v1.1.3
releases.body:
## New

- **Cheats:** GameShark, Action Replay and CodeBreaker codes for each game. Add or import them in Settings > CHEATS (or a game's library menu > CHEATS), and turn them on or off from the companion's SETTINGS > CHEATS. RetroAchievements pauses while any cheat is on.
- **Phones held upright:** the game sits across the top with the companion docked under it. Drag the grip to resize it, or tap it to step through small, normal and full.
- **External controllers** (8BitDo, GameSir, Xbox, ...) connect mid-game without restarting it. HOME / guide acts as BACK for the companion, and the touch controls hide once a controller is used.
- **Shaders:** a new LCD PAPER filter, a GRID strength setting, and ON COMPANION, which puts the filter and GBA COLORS on the companion screen too (Android 13+).
- **Companion settings:** RESUME GAMES, CLOSE COMPANION, the status bar over the companion, and TWEAKS (icon bounce, map cursor blink, tab animations, jump to battle).
- **New look:** the PokéDaisy theme is the new default for the library and settings, with a new app icon. The game-coloured themes are still in Settings > THEME.
- **Website:** [pokedaisy.web.app](https://pokedaisy.web.app) has a ROM checker that runs in your browser, so your ROM is never uploaded.

## ROMs

- **New languages:** FireRed, LeafGreen, Ruby and Sapphire in Spanish, German, French, Italian and Japanese, plus English Ruby / Sapphire rev 0.
- **Emerald** in Spanish, German, French, Italian and Japanese. Pokémon, moves, items and places show in the game's language.
- **Pokémon Yellow is back**, now with sound, steady fast-forward music, touch battle controls and a Pokédex.
- **New versions:** Pokémon Amethyst 1.4.1 and a second build of SoulGold 1.2.

## Changes

- **Fast-forward defaults to 2×** (it was 6×). Pick another speed in SETTINGS > FF SPEED.
- **A, B, X and Y are no longer swapped by default** on AYN and Retroid devices. This only applies to new installs: if you're updating, your buttons stay as they are. You can remap them in SETTINGS > GAME BUTTONS.

## Fixes

- Updates open Android's own installer, not another app that opens APKs.
- On Android 8-10, storage access and the folder picker work (the picker opens on internal storage, not Downloads).
- Pokémon Yellow was silent, and its companion was slow.

releases.name: v1.1.2
releases.body:
## New

- **Single-screen devices:** the companion is now a side panel. Tap BACK to slide it over the game. Tap the padlock tab to lock it next to the game, and drag the tab to resize it. Tested on the Retroid Pocket 6.
- **SWAP SCREENS** (SETTINGS > SCREEN, dual-screen devices only): puts the game on the second display and the companion on the main one, for devices whose main display is the bottom screen, like the Anbernic RG DS. Not tested on an RG DS yet.
- **Shaders** (SETTINGS > SHADERS, on either screen): LCD, SCANLINES and CRT filters, plus GBA COLORS. You can use a filter and GBA COLORS together.
- **Wider companion layouts** for 16:9 screens: the party shows in 3 columns, and the map keeps its shape.
- **Updates** now open Android's installer directly.

## ROMs

- **New:** Pokémon SoulGold 1.2.
- **SoulGold / Lazarus:** the full party shows, eggs are marked, and SoulGold's icons have the right colors.

## Fixes

- Fixed crashes, high memory use and CPU spikes when switching tabs.
- SWAP SCREENS no longer disappears from SETTINGS after swapping.

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
## Read this first: the app was renamed

PokeDaisey is now **PokeDaisy**. Android treats it as a new app, so the in-app updater installs it next to the old one instead of replacing it. Deleting the old PokeDaisey isn't mandatory, but if you don't, your device will show both apps.

If your ROMs and saves live in your own folders (like RetroArch's), just point the new app at them in the first-time setup. Only saves kept in the old app's own folder (`Android/data/com.pokedaisey.app/`) need copying out before you uninstall. Settings start fresh. If you launch from iiSU or ES-DE, the target is now `com.pokedaisy.app/.LaunchActivity`.

## New

- **RetroAchievements (beta, softcore only):** CHEEVOS tab, unlock popups, leaderboards, the game's own fanfare on every unlock. Sign in from the top-screen Settings. Hardcore isn't supported yet: RA doesn't accept it from an unrecognised emulator, and it would need save-state loads and touch battle input blocked.
- **IVs, EVs, nature and Hidden Power** on the party summary (STATS), and in battle INFO next to the foe's (foe IVs: SETTINGS > FOE IVS, off by default).
- **6 languages** for the app's text: English, Japanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish (LANGUAGE in Settings).
- **Zipped ROMs** (`.zip`, `.7z`), clean game names, RetroAchievements box art as a cover source, Library Refresh results.
- **Stretch option** for 16:9 top screens, a second START/SELECT on X/Y, hotkeys on/off.
- **Setup guides** for launching from [iiSU](https://pokedaisy.com/guides/iisu/) and [ES-DE](https://pokedaisy.com/guides/es-de/).

## ROMs

- **New:** Pokémon SoulGold 1.1.4.
- **Lazarus:** region map, touch battle controls, STEADY fast-forward music.
- **Radical Red:** correct names, moves, items and sprites.
- **Emerald Seaglass:** battle tab, move types and its own map.

## Fixes

- A resume state could overwrite a changed save with a blank one. Resume now checks the save first, and every start backs it up (RESTORE BACKUP in the Library).
- Releasing one of two held keys (START + X) no longer releases the other.
- The BATTLE tab no longer opens empty on games with unmapped battle data.

releases.name: v1.0.4
releases.body:
The first public release of PokeDaisy: Gen 3 Pokémon on the top screen, and a live companion for the game you're playing on the bottom screen.

**Devices:** AYN Thor (tested). Retroid Pocket Duo / Duo Lite should work but haven't been tried on real hardware yet.

**No games are included.** Use your own legally dumped ROMs.

## Install

1. Download `PokeDaisey-1.0.4.apk` below and open it on the device. Allow installing from your browser or file manager when Android asks.

2. On first launch, setup walks you through linking your ROMs folder, choosing a saves folder (another emulator's, such as RetroArch's, works), and optionally adding a SteamGridDB key for cover art.

The app checks for new versions each time it opens and offers to update. You can also check from Settings > VERSION.

## What's in it

- **Companion:** party, bag, battle info and suggestions, map, Pokédex, guide (where to go, the next boss, evolutions), trainer card and save states, all in the game's own menu style.
- **Player:** smart fast-forward, fast-forward music, slow motion, save states with undo, status bar, remappable buttons and hotkeys, themes.
- **Library:** covers, recently played, rename, hide, load a save file into a game (the current save is kept as a dated backup), and per-game info. Works with ES-DE, Cocoon and iiSU.

## Supported games

FireRed, LeafGreen, Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, Pokémon Unbound, Radical Red, Gaia, Odyssey, Heart and Soul, Amethyst, Celia's Stupid Romhack, Lazarus, Emerald Seaglass, Too Many Types 2 and Emerald Rogue. See the [README](https://pokedaisy.com/compatibility/) for exact versions and what works in each. Other GBA games play, without the companion.

Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://pokedaisy.com/feedback/#bug).
